'''Aeon Durron''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was part of an Imperial strike team during the events of the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. He acted as a supply officer who specialized in crafting goods.
